policies.title: Israeli citizens: citizenship entry status
policies.summary: An Israeli ordinary passport represents citizenship rather than a visitor-visa or ETA route; the current ETA-IL guidance expressly excludes Israeli citizens from ETA-IL applications.
conditions: This records citizenship, not a visitor-visa waiver or a decision on admission for a non-citizen travel document.

The current ETA-IL guidance says Israeli citizens do not need ETA-IL; it separately addresses an Israeli individual travelling on a foreign passport, so that dual-document situation is not normalized here.
Permanent residents with an Israeli identity number are a separate status-specific ETA exception, not a citizenship rule in this ordinary-passport policy.

policies.title: Visa-exempt ordinary national passports: ETA-IL required
policies.summary: The listed current visa-exempt ordinary national-passport rows require a pre-travel ETA-IL for visitor travel to Israel; this is normalized as ETA, not visa-free, from 1 January 2025.
conditions: The cohort is limited to the corresponding current Population and Immigration Authority rows for a regular national passport. It does not establish access for laissez-passer, refugee, stateless, identity, or another non-national travel document.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs says all visitors from visa-exempt countries need ETA-IL. The official visitor-visa table separately distinguishes national, diplomatic, official, service and biometric document fields; these grouped ISO codes must not be read as covering those other fields.

ETA-IL applies to a visitor stay of up to 90 days or less. Approval is valid for up to two years or until the current passport expires, whichever occurs first; a name, gender or citizenship change requires a new authorization.

Israeli citizens, permanent residents with an Israeli identity number, official or diplomatic passport holders, specified official-mission diplomats, qualifying seamen, reported aircrew, and some Israeli dual-document cases are separately described ETA exceptions. They are not flattened into this ordinary-passport nationality rule.
ETA-IL is not a guarantee of entry. The official notice says immigration officials conduct a security check and determine entry on arrival.

This is a short visitor-entry classification only. It does not establish rights for employment, residence, transit, Palestinian travel documents, or a special territorial or document status beyond the exact regular-passport row.

application.label: Population and Immigration Authority ETA-IL application
application.processingTime: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs ETA-IL service says an answer is sent within 72 hours after submission.
steps: Confirm that the exact regular national-passport country or territory row is visa-exempt and that no separate status or document exception applies.
Open the official Population and Immigration Authority ETA-IL form and complete the application with the passport to be used for travel.
Submit the application before travel and travel only after approval, using the same current passport.

policies.title: Ordinary national passports requiring an Israeli visitor visa
policies.summary: The listed current regular national-passport rows require a visitor visa for ordinary short visitor travel to Israel, subject only to a directly stated document-, status-, purpose-, residence- or security-specific exception.
conditions: This is only the current regular national-passport complement directly identified by the Population and Immigration Authority data and Ministry of Foreign Affairs country/document table. It does not classify diplomatic, official, service, biometric, laissez-passer, refugee, stateless or other special travel documents.

For a visiting or touring B/2 application, the official service describes applications through the relevant Israeli mission abroad or the Population and Immigration Authority. The application and eventual entry decision remain case-specific.

The visitor-visa service says a foreigner from a country defined by security services as high-risk needs an additional resume form for security clearance. This candidate does not infer, publish or normalize a nationality list from that status-dependent rule.

The eVisa-B2 pilot is not a universal reclassification of this cohort: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs limits it to Indian and Sri Lankan passport holders residing in India and Sri Lanka. All other residence, purpose and consular requirements remain material.

This policy does not establish work, residence, transit, group-tour, Palestinian-document, prior-history, or border-admission access, and must not be read as an assurance that a B/2 visa will be issued or that entry will be permitted.

application.label: Population and Immigration Authority B/2 tourist and visitor visa service
steps: Confirm the passport's current regular-national document row and whether a narrow residence-, document- or purpose-specific route changes how the application is made.
Complete the B/2 entry-visa request and submit it with the passport and required supporting documents at the relevant Israeli mission abroad or Population and Immigration Authority office.
Provide any additional security-clearance or case-specific documents requested by the relevant authority before travel.
